query:
-- Find the car first
SELECT id, make, model, year, price, mileage, dealerId FROM cars 
WHERE make = 'KIA' AND model = 'EV6' AND year = 2023 
  AND price = 29995
  AND dealerId IN (SELECT id FROM dealers WHERE name LIKE '%EMG%')
LIMIT 1;
